About

LMSVanilla is a carefully curated Minecraft survival server focused on authentic vanilla gameplay with a competitive lifesteal twist. No pay-to-win. No clutter. Just a high-performance world where community, skill, and exploration matter.

Features

Everything you need for a premium survival experience.

Vanilla Gameplay

Stay true to Minecraft with a clean, vanilla-first experience.

Lifesteal

Earn hearts through PvP and defend what you've fought for.

Community Driven

A welcoming player base built around fair play and teamwork.

High Performance

Powerful hardware tuned for low latency and stable TPS.

24/7 Uptime

Always online so you can jump in whenever you're ready.

Optimized for Smooth Gameplay

Carefully configured for buttery-smooth survival sessions.
